profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft, according to its own site. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. It is headquartered at Starbase, Texas, and is a for-profit public company traded under the ticker SPCX, with SEC CIK 0001181412.

The company's own description centers on launch vehicles and spacecraft rather than on named AI products, and no AI products or MCP servers are recorded for it. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Texas, with a count of 125, and no individual cases are listed.
